D2 余 - 裕: surplus; something to spare versus abundant; room to spare

D4 栄 - 裕: flourish; prosperity versus rich; abundant
D5 資 - 裕: resources; capital versus wealth; rich

D8 多 - 裕: many, much versus abundant
D9 優 - 裕: superior / amply (優に) versus abundant; ample
D10 濃 - 裕: concentrated; rich (flavor) versus rich
D11 幸 - 裕: happiness; good fortune versus fortune; rich
D12 剰 - 裕: surplus amount versus abundant; spare
D13 充 - 裕: fill; sufficient versus abundant; ample
D14 悠 - 裕: leisurely; unhurried versus leeway; composure
D15 金 - 裕: gold, money versus rich; wealthy
D16 貨 - 裕: goods; currency versus riches; wealth
E1 厚 - the 裕 card's exclusion rationale relies on 厚's ordinary secondary sense "abundant"; its card text is needed to judge that disposition
